brief: Owner brief 2026-10-18 (Italian): whole-document reading, restriction review, rule improvement, operational benefit. Measure how much available evidence reaches each stage, how much is interpreted correctly, how much is lost; separate coverage, attribution, scientific correctness, justified ambiguity and unjustified abstention; preserve first runs; separate development data, already-examined data and authentic new data.
registeredBefore: any whole-document reader code exists; the reference is sealed before the first run

dataClasses.development: the 69 unique retained pages of earlier experiments (spent). All tuning happens here.
dataClasses.alreadyExamined: the HTML table values of the KV page kru_dh_mc_12l (scored in KV, then tuned on: P2). Reported separately, never as held-out.
dataClasses.authenticNew: everything outside HTML tables on the 7 fetched KV pages (paragraphs, lists, cards, captions, embedded JSON-LD and hydration data). Fetched 2026-10-18 for KV; their non-table content was never read by the developer: only location counts were taken (number of quantities per location). These are new documents for this reader; vacuumwars.com is also a new publisher and robot vacuums a category with no teaching.

reference.annotators: fresh-context Claude agents with no access to the reader code, its outputs or the developer's notes; they read a neutral rendering only. Same model family as the developer: frozen, not author-independent (skill: 'Frozen does not mean author-independent').
reference.input: per page: the visible text rendered by Chromium with JavaScript disabled and the network blocked (innerText, split into numbered lines; lines inside HTML tables flagged and excluded from annotation), and a data view: every string and number leaf of the page's JSON-LD and of its inline hydration payloads (Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ and self.__next_f flight data, other application/json scripts), flattened to numbered 'path: value' lines. Kept only on the container disk next to the raw pages (never committed).

items.quantity: every numeric expression outside tables that states a property, result, setting, condition, price or count about a product or a test: page, line, printed surface; class (measurement_result | declared_specification | test_condition | setting | price | rating_score | count | identifier_or_name_part | warranty_or_service | other_non_quantity); product (as named on the page, or 'page_subject', or 'none_or_unclear'); property in a few words and the knowledge's metric id when one fits; kind id from the knowledge list, or 'not_determinable_from_page' with a reason; conditions (axis id or free label, value as printed); evidence class (publisher_measured | manufacturer_declared | derived_or_estimated | unknown); whether the same statement repeats another item (duplicate_of).
items.qualitative: every evaluative statement about a product's performance or behaviour (e.g. 'annoying vibration at the highest speed'): page, line, aspect (a few words), polarity (positive | negative | mixed), product, conditions, basis (tested_experience | opinion_without_test | reported_by_others | manufacturer_claim), author when the page names one.
items.noTextCopy: annotators never copy sentences: surfaces are the printed numeric expressions only; properties and aspects are paraphrased in a few words.

reference.sealing: the reference files are hashed into evaluation/whole-document/gold-freeze.json and committed before the first run.

arms.A_live: the readers the live path persists today (Phase245 declarations, Phase225/265 test leads, Phase270 comparative results, Phase269 qualitative codes), unchanged.
arms.B_tables: the knowledge layer as it is (1G tables + quantity knowledge qk.2.2 + kr.1): reads tables only.
arms.C_whole: the whole-document reader built in WD-B/WD-C (frozen by commit hash before the run).

scoring.match: a reader item matches a reference quantity when it is on the same page, its segment text maps to the same rendered line (normalised whitespace, or the data-view line for embedded data) and its printed surface has the same number and unit after normalisation. Duplicates in the reference count once.

perItem.kind: correct | unjustified_interpretation (wrong kind, or a kind where the reference says not determinable) | unjustified_abstention (no kind where the reference gives one) | justified_abstention
perItem.nonQuantity: an item the reference classes as identifier_or_name_part, warranty_or_service, price or other_non_quantity but the reader types as a measurement = wrong conclusion
perItem.product: correct | wrong | missing (reader none, reference names one) | justified_none
perItem.metric: correct | wrong | missing (reference gives a metric id, reader none)
perItem.conditions: per reference condition: attributed | not_attributed; reader conditions absent from the reference: spurious

scoring.wrongConclusion: any of: unjustified kind interpretation, non-quantity typed as a measurement, wrong product, wrong metric, spurious condition, wrong evidence class
scoring.qualitative: matched by page and line; then aspect (judged by overlap of the reader's aspect id with the reference paraphrase, recorded per item), polarity, product, conditions
scoring.reportedBy: data class, page, publisher novelty (new publisher / known publisher), location (paragraph, list, card, caption, embedded)

firstRun: each arm is run once on the authentic data; outputs are committed unchanged. Any change after the first run is reported as TUNED on a separate label.
boundaries: store, ranking, retention and access rules unchanged; no new acquisition; no Git history change; no page text in either repository.
